description: This file defines the IntervalDict class, a dict-like data structure mapping intervals or single values to data, with methods for range queries, merging, and manipulation.

classes.name: IntervalDict
classes.description: A dict-like structure mapping intervals or single values to data, supporting range queries and merging.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes an IntervalDict, optionally from a mapping or iterable.

methods.name: _from_items
methods.description: Creates an IntervalDict quickly from a list of (key, value) pairs with disjoint keys.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all items from the IntervalDict.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Returns a shallow copy of the IntervalDict.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves value(s) associated with a key or interval, with default fallback.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds an interval where the value matches the given value.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns a view of all items.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns a view of all keys.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a view of all values.

methods.name: domain
methods.description: Returns an Interval covering all keys.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns a value or interval, depending on key type.

methods.name: popitem
methods.description: Removes and returns an arbitrary (key, value) pair.

methods.name: setdefault
methods.description: Returns a key's value, setting it if absent.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the dict with another mapping or iterable.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Combines two IntervalDicts, merging overlapping intervals with a function.

methods.name: as_dict
methods.description: Returns the contents as a standard Python dict.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves value(s) for a key or interval.

methods.name: __setitem__
methods.description: Sets value(s) for a key or interval, merging overlapping intervals.

methods.name: __delitem__
methods.description: Deletes a key or interval.

methods.name: __or__
methods.description: Returns a new IntervalDict as the union of self and another.

methods.name: __ior__
methods.description: In-place union with another IntervalDict.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Returns an iterator over keys.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of stored interval or key entries.

methods.name: __contains__
methods.description: Checks if a key or interval is in the domain.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the IntervalDict.

methods.name: __eq__
methods.description: Checks equality with another IntervalDict.
